description: This Java source file defines a utility class HonoProtonHelper with static methods for managing AMQP links and sessions using Vert.x and Proton libraries. It includes methods for setting detach and close handlers, executing code on specific Vert.x contexts, and closing/freeing links reliably.

classes.name: HonoProtonHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to work with Proton and Vert.x AMQP links and sessions, such as setting handlers and gracefully closing links.

methods.name: setDetachHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler invoked on receiving an AMQP detach frame with close property false, and frees the link.

methods.name: setCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler invoked on receiving an AMQP detach frame with close property true, and frees the link.

methods.name: setDefaultCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a default handler on a link to respond and free resources when a close is received.

methods.name: setDefaultCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a default handler on a session to close and free resources when an end frame is received.

methods.name: isLinkEstablished
methods.description: Checks whether an AMQP link has been established based on remote target/source properties.

methods.name: executeOrRunOnContext
methods.description: Executes a given code handler on a specified Vert.x context, returning a Future representing the result.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes a link and frees resources, with default timeout.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes a link and frees resources, waiting for peer detach or timeout.
